goal:
T48 — Arena fairness manifest (v3.6 feedback §2.2, §7.4; acceptance AT-17/AT-18). Every arena must state, before
and after it runs, that both lanes got the same task and the same held-out tests, and what each lane was allowed.

Edit services/api/evoforge/arena.py (T44 engine) only, plus your tests:
- Add a "manifest" dict to every arena document, already present in the running document that seed_running stores at
  POST time, unchanged in the finished document, and included in GET /v1/arena list rows:
  * comparison_mode: "same_task_same_tests_concurrent"
  * suite_version, task_id
  * task_spec_hash: "sha256:" + sha256 hex of json.dumps({"goal": task["goal"], "files": task["files"]},
    sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) encoded utf-8  (exactly what both Builders are given)
  * heldout_hash: "sha256:" + sha256 hex of json.dumps([{"id": h["id"], "code": h["code"]} for h in
    task["heldout"]], sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))  (proves the same tests without revealing them)
  * heldout_count: len(task["heldout"])
  * base_tree_sha: the 40-hex git tree id of the task base commit (git rev-parse <base>^{tree}); deterministic for
    the same files. Compute it at POST time (a temporary repo via sealed_eval._make_task_source_repo is fine; clean up).
  * lanes: {"single": {"model", "harness": "api-sealed-eval/1", "max_attempts": 1, "critic": false,
    "feedback": "none"}, "evoforge": {"model", "harness": "api-sealed-eval/2", "max_attempts":
    sealed_eval.PIPELINE_MAX_ATTEMPTS, "feedback": "heldout_failing_test_names"}}  (if a critic feedback mode exists
    and is used, say "critic")
  * cost_basis: "model_api_usage"; runner_cost: "not_measured"
  * disclosure: one plain sentence that the EvoForge lane retries with the names of failing held-out tests (an upper
    bound, an oracle signal the single lane does not get) and that Runner compute is not included in cost.
- Each lane also records its own "base_tree_sha" from the repo it actually built (must equal the manifest's).
- No held-out code or reference fix anywhere in the manifest. Do not change lane scoring, verdict or patch semantics.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t48.py.
